description.narrative: While significant progress has been made towards achieving gender equality in Cambodia, there exist economic, cultural, social and other factors that continue to challenge the inclusion and empowerment of people of all genders in Cambodia. This project seeks to transform institutions to address the barriers to achieving gender equality, supported by tools, processes, research, evidence and the capacity required to support achieve long-term and sustainable progress. To reduce the institutional, economic, cultural and mental barriers holding back the achievement of gender equality, a holistic approach is required, bringing the right partners, including government, civil society and the private sector together to make a maximum impact. The result is an institutional ecosystem that is more gender-transformative, empowered by capacity and knowledge, and better able to mainstream gender to achieve real result for women and men in Cambodia.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
